verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. Leaving looks easy in practice, though: prompts, audio and images stay on the device and work offline without an account, and the hosted endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so standard clients can be repointed elsewhere. These are only indirect signals of portability. Missing for 10: a documented export of account/cloud data (e.g., usage history), any statement of open export formats, an account-deletion or offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
